text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's finance minister Herbert Murerwa will on Thursday unveil an annual budget to a nation with varied expectations.

- Ashanti Goldfields Zimbabwe Ltd's managing director Mike Marriot has called it quits a year after his appointment and has been replaced by South African Alan Dobbs who arrived at the mining group this month.

- Harare City Council on Wednesday approved a Z$2.97 billion budget to run and develop the city for the next 18 months which will see rates and supplementary charges for all properties going up by between 25 and 35 percent.
- President Robert Mugabe on Wednesday announced a cabinet reshuffle in which he cut the number of government ministries by three.

- President Mugabe on Wednesday criticised the United States for marginalising Africa and regarding it as part of the world that "belonged to Europe", saying more American investment in the continent would help erase the negative image.
